rounds.oldMeaning: Lefoko moruti le ne le raya motho yo o rutang kgotsa yo o kaelang ba bangwe mo thutong.
rounds.story: Le tswa mo go ruta. Fa kereke e gola, lefoko la simolola go kaya thata moeteledipele wa kereke.

rounds.oldMeaning: Koloi e ne e le kariki kgotsa sengwe se se gogiwang ke diphologolo go rwala batho kgotsa merwalo.
rounds.story: E ne e le kariki pele. Fa dikoloi tsa motoro di tlhaga, leina la fetela mo dipalangweng tsotlhe tsa mofuta oo.

rounds.oldMeaning: Mogala o ne o raya thapo, mola wa tshipi kgotsa sengwe se seleele se se golaganyang dilo.
rounds.story: Megala ya puisano e ne ya dira gore lefoko le simolole go kaya le founo ka boyona.

rounds.oldMeaning: Lentswe le ne le raya modumo o o tswang mo molomong wa motho fa a bua kgotsa a opela.
rounds.story: Mo dipolotiking, go bua se o se ratang ga fetoga go ntsha lentswe, ke gore tlhopho.

rounds.oldMeaning: Maranyane a ne a raya dikgwele tse segokgo se di logang go tshwara dikokonyana.
rounds.story: Ka ntlha ya dikgokagano tse dintsi tse di golagantsweng, leina la maranyane la dirisiwa mo inthaneteng.

rounds.oldMeaning: Toropo, e e tswang mo lefokong la Seaforikane dorp, e ne e raya motsana o monnye.
rounds.story: Fa mafelo a ne a gola, toropo ya simolola go kaya motse o mogolo go na le motsana.

rounds.oldMeaning: Setulo e ne e le selo sa go nna mo go sona, jaaka sedulo kgotsa setilo.
rounds.story: Fa motho a tlhomiwa go nna mo setulong sengwe, lefoko la simolola go raya tiro kgotsa maemo ao.

rounds.oldMeaning: Kgoro e ne e raya kgoro ya lolwapa kgotsa tsela ya go tsena mo gae.
rounds.story: Mo pusong, mafapha a ne a bidiwa dikgoro, jaaka e kete ke ditsela tsa go tsena mo tirong e e rileng.

rounds.oldMeaning: Setshwantsho se ne se raya sengwe le sengwe se se tshwantshang selo, jaaka penta, seema kgotsa mokwalo.
rounds.story: Ka go ata ga khamera, batho ba simolola go dirisa setshwantsho thata fa ba raya foto.

rounds.oldMeaning: Mophato o ne o raya setlhopha sa basha kgotsa banna ba ba kopantsweng ka dingwaga kgotsa tirelo.
rounds.story: Go tswa mo ditlhopheng tsa dingwaga, lefoko la fetela mo maemong a sekolo le a tiro.

rounds.oldMeaning: Motse o ne o raya lapa kgotsa bodulo jwa lelapa le le lengwe, le mabala a lone.
rounds.story: Fa bodulo bo gola, motse wa tloga mo lapeng le le lengwe wa ya go raya lefelo le legolo la bonno.

rounds.oldMeaning: Morafe o ne o raya batho ba ba busiwang ke kgosi e le nngwe le naga ya bone.
rounds.story: Fa dipuso tsa segompieno di gola, morafe wa atologela go kaya setshaba kgotsa baagi ka kakaretso.
